throttling.description: How Lighthouse slows the network and CPU while it measures: simulated from a fast run (Lighthouse's default), applied in the browser, or not at all.
throttling.help: How Lighthouse slows network and CPU while it measures: simulate derives mobile timings from a fast run (Lighthouse's default), devtools applies them in the browser, provided measures as the view is.
throttling.label: Throttling

reportWindow.description: Where a Lighthouse report opens: in the one report window, which each report replaces, or in a window of its own per report.
reportWindow.help: Where a Lighthouse report opens: single shows each report in the one report window; perReport opens a window per report, so two runs stand side by side.
reportWindow.label: Report window

keepRuns.description: How many Lighthouse runs stay in .rbrowser/out/lighthouse; after each run the oldest beyond this number are deleted. 0 keeps every run (the default).
keepRuns.help: How many Lighthouse runs stay on disk; after each run the oldest beyond this number are deleted with their reports. 0 keeps every run.
keepRuns.label: Runs kept

tools.cancel: Cancels the Lighthouse run going on and every queued breakpoint; answers how many were cancelled.
tools.run: Runs Lighthouse for every Chromium breakpoint (or those named in breakpoints, or the view of target) with its own emulation, one after another, in a headless browser of its own - the views do not navigate. categories (performance, accessibility, best-practices, seo) overrides the project's checks.lighthouse.categories; url overrides each view's page, on a site the views show unless a person switched on plugins.lighthouseAnyUrl (else plugins.error.sidecar_url_denied). Answers the scores per breakpoint (0-100), the paths of the HTML and JSON reports under .rbrowser/out/lighthouse/, the number of failed audits, and the breakpoints skipped with the reason (Firefox and WebKit).
tools.status: Answers the Lighthouse run going on (the breakpoint measured, how many wait) and the scores of the last run with the previous run's for comparison.
tools.reports: The Lighthouse runs on disk and their reports. action list (the default) answers every run, newest first, with its start time, breakpoints, scores and report paths below .rbrowser/out/lighthouse/; open shows a report in rBrowser's report window (run: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS, else the newest; breakpoint, else the target view's or the active view's), only in a trusted project; compare answers two runs of one breakpoint (runs: two run ids, else the two newest) with the scores and the metrics FCP, LCP, TBT, CLS and Speed Index, each with its change. Deleting runs is not offered.
